label_table_name.description: 1. Data | Actual outcomes table for performance monitoring: short name in the input schema or catalog.schema.table. Blank disables label-based monitoring

label_available_at_column.description: 1. Data | UTC timestamp column recording when the actual outcome became available; required with an outcomes table

monitoring_catalog.description: 6. Deployment | Monitoring store catalog for drift and performance tracking. Use the same catalog and schema in every project so all models appear in one dashboard. Leave blank to start without monitoring; enable it later in deployment/variables.yml

monitoring_schema.description: 6. Deployment | Shared monitoring store schema; omitted or blank uses skyulf_monitoring when a catalog is set. Choose another existing store if needed. Ignored when the catalog is blank. Created on first use when the run-as identity may create schemas

monitoring_dashboard.description: 6. Deployment | Monitoring dashboard: one dashboard shows every model in this monitoring store. create makes it in this project (choose create only in the first project using this store); connect links a dashboard another project created; none adds no dashboard. Requires a monitoring store. This answer sets up the test target only; set syst and prod by hand in deployment/dashboards.yml, which explains both choices

monitoring_dashboard_warehouse_id.description: 6. Deployment | SQL warehouse ID (16 hexadecimal characters; SQL Warehouses > your warehouse > Connection details, or the warehouse page URL) that runs the dashboard queries. Required for create; for connect, blank keeps the published dashboard's warehouse

monitoring_dashboard_url.description: 6. Deployment | Published dashboard URL from the project that created it, for example https://<workspace>/dashboardsv3/<id>/published

performance_policy_mode.description: 6. Monitoring | off disables loss policy; report records loss; retrain may request guarded training. Requires an outcomes table and monitoring store

performance_regression_metric.description: 6. Monitoring | Regression metric for completed outcome windows; WAPE is undefined when total absolute actual outcome is zero

performance_classification_metric.description: 6. Monitoring | Classification metric for completed outcome windows; model-set branches each keep their own metric and baseline

performance_tolerance_mode.description: 6. Monitoring | relative scales the allowed loss by the absolute baseline; absolute uses metric units

performance_tolerance.description: 6. Monitoring | Allowed performance loss: 0.2 means 20% of baseline in relative mode, or 0.2 metric units in absolute mode

performance_baseline_version.description: 6. Monitoring | Concrete registered model version whose saved holdout supplies the baseline. Verify it before activation; edit each component policy if model-set versions differ
